description: Question/answer list. interactive: true uses <details> for accordion behavior (preferred for >5 items). interactive: false renders as a static block (better for printable / SEO-only pages with 3-4 items).

items.hint: 4-8 items. Questions written in the customer's voice ('Can I cancel?', not 'Cancellation policy'). Answers 1-3 sentences. Don't use FAQ as a marketing surface — answer the real question, link out if it gets long.

interactive.hint: true uses native <details> accordion. false renders open list. Default true.

items.question: Can I export the site outside LanderPilot?
items.answer: Yes — every site is a real Astro project in your workspace. You own the files. Run `npm run build` anywhere.

items.question: Do I have to use the cloud deploy helper?
items.answer: No. The deploy step is separate. You can upload the dist/ folder to any static host.

items.question: Can I customize the industry themes?
items.answer: Yes. Each theme is a JSON file with DaisyUI variables — duplicate one, change colors, save under a new name.
